about: Loader calls that stand in for each other, read from mods that ship for more than one loader (bench/loader_api.py). counterparts: two calls proven at one switch or one method, where each loader's side made that one loader call (how: one) or they alone share a class name and member (how: name). used: every loader call two or more of these mods make, and the loaders a counterpart is known on.
